title: Bali BNB
style: Comedy pop-reggaeton with dembow bounce and cheeky chant hooks; verse rides playful call-and-response, pre-chorus strips to handclaps, beatbox, and ukulele plucks, chorus hits with gang vocals, harmonica answers, and cartoonish ad-libs. Duo-family vocals are stacked, panned, and traded like a relay. Riser sweeps, bird-call stabs, sidechain swells; bright, tropical, punchy mix., happy, bounce, oi, comedy
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Corey in the BNB, happy brain on glow
Dunedin to the island, mate, look at him go
Mishy Mish Mash with the pickleball flex
“Keep it neat, keep it sweet” — that’s coach’s text

Ruby Roo Roo, art in the air
Paint on her fingers, pride in her stare
“My art stays with me,” she says, chin up high
Wesley on the game, big grin, “let’s try”

[Pre-Chorus]
Aussie sun, Bali breeze
Makin’ trouble? Nah, makin’ memories
Where’s Michelle? She’s off she goes
Backyard investigator, nose on toes

[Chorus]
Bali BNB, never ending holiday
Bali BNB, we do it the Aussie way
Aussie aussie aussie, here aha here
Oi oi oi, we’re all right here
Bali BNB, never ending holiday
(platt your hair) and float away

[Verse 2]
Wezza with the licks, a little español
“Hola, bro” then “go, go, go”
Bo bo bo, and aye aye aye
He’s got that comedy in both his eyes

Black toy poodle, Ashley on patrol
Aussie little sniffer, doing the role
“Where’s Michelle?” and off she flies
Super dog speed with detective eyes

[Pre-Chorus]
Two dogs, lots of frogs
A backyard mission through the mangroves and logs
“What’s that?” — SSatt on the case
Sounds of Australia in a Bali place

[Chorus]
Bali BNB, never ending holiday
Bali BNB, we do it the Aussie way
Aussie aussie aussie, here aha here
Oi oi oi, we’re all right here
Bali BNB, never ending holiday
(platt your hair) and float away

[Bridge]
Corey codes the super-smart machine
Turning forwards backwards, upside down, clean
“Whatcha da pelican reckon?” — make us laugh
Rotto quokka bounce and a galah on the path

[M] and [F]
Ruby Roo Roo Roo, kanga bounce!
Wezza, Wezza, big voice — one more ounce!
Mishy Mish Mash, clap that beat
Ashley and Aussie got nimble feet

[Final Chorus]
Bali BNB, never ending holiday
Bali BNB, we do it the Aussie way
Aussie aussie aussie, here aha here
Oi oi oi, we’re all right here
Bali BNB, never ending holiday
(never ending holiday) all day, okay!
